主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. appointed Mark Carney as Vice Chair and Head of ESG and Impact Fund Investing on August 26, 2020. Carney, former Governor of the Bank of England and Bank of Canada, will oversee ESG-focused investment strategies. The appointment aims to expand ESG investing capabilities by developing funds that combine positive social and environmental outcomes with strong risk-adjusted returns. Carney emphasized the importance of transitioning to a net zero economy and leveraging Brookfield’s leadership in renewable energy and sustainability. The move reflects Brookfield’s long-term commitment to ESG principles and its position as a leading player in the renewable energy sector.
